title: Syllabus
text:
Course Title
Secure Public Cloud Services


Duration
12 weeks


Mode of Delivery
In-person


Instructor
John Jennings


Email
john.jennings@tus.ie






This module delves into advanced cloud architecture design principles, aligning with the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) curriculum. Students will gain a comprehensive understanding of how to design and deploy secure, scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective applications on AWS. Through hands-on labs and real-world case studies, students will develop the practical skills necessary to become proficient AWS cloud architects.



By the end of this course, students will be able to:

Analyse the main principles of cloud computing and how they have been implemented in modern cloud providers such as AWS
Define a solution using architectural design principles based on customer requirements
Assess various cloud architectures and implementations that solve common infrastructure issues
Implement a cloud based architecture based on well designed architectural principles





Public Cloud Architectures

Global Cloud Infrastructure
Compute, Storage, Networking
Managed Services

Design Resilient Architectures

High Availability
Load-balancing

Design High-Performing Architectures

Auto-scaling
Automation
Decoupling Infrastructure
Web-Scale Media
CDN’s

Design Secure Applications and Architectures

Shared Security Model
Users, Groups, Roles, IAM
Authentication, Authorisation
Bastion Hosts,

Design Cost-Optimised Architectures

Cloud Pricing Models
Cost Optimisation
Service Optimisation
Architecture Optimisation
